summary: Provision time-bound telemetry bridge role (AWS/GCP) for private prod metrics debugging
description: Request to provision a short-lived, tightly scoped cross-cloud telemetry bridge role used by the on-prem metrics forwarder and the monitoring project to read log/metric buckets during a validation window for Private deployments. Current problem: the forwarder used for private prod validation cannot assume the required cross-account role and we are blocked from completing a metrics sanity check for a customer's private deployment. This ticket tracks the access request, constraints, audit expectations, and rollout/cleanup plan.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy private deployment validation harness (on-prem forwarder) in diagnostics sandbox
2) Run metrics collection job referencing monitoring project log buckets (projects/monitoring-prod-llm/logs/*)
3) Observe failure when the forwarder attempts to assume the monitoring-read role via STS or when the monitoring service account attempts to grant actAs to the forwarder
4) Error observed: access denied from both AWS STS chain and GCP iam.serviceAccounts.actAs path
logs: 2026-03-09T17:42:11Z forwarder-prod: ERROR AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/forwarder-temp-role/session is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/monitoring-read-role
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: STS assume-role call blocked due to missing aws:PrincipalTag condition expected by the monitoring role (recent enforcement change to tag-bound assume).
GCP side shows policy binding that requires request.time < 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z and a constraint on accessContextManager; our forwarder does not satisfy the condition.
Confirmed forwarder can reach STS and Identity endpoints (no network egress issues).
Reproduce test: assume-role call from a dev session succeeds when principal tag is present (manually added), fails without it; indicates role condition enforcement.
Related: monitoring-read-role was updated by infra PR 1942 to add tag-based restrictions (see related_github_prs).
requested_change: Create a temporary bridge role (both AWS and GCP) that allows the diagnostics forwarder principal to read logs/metrics from the monitoring project for a 72-hour window. Constraints requested: max-session-duration=3600s, require aws:SourceIp range limited to Redwood corporate egress, require aws:PrincipalTag 'diag-request' set=true, include CloudTrail and Stackdriver audit logging enabled with retention for 90 days. On GCP, bind roles/logging.viewer and roles/monitoring.viewer to a dedicated service account with an IAM Condition limiting access by request.time and origin IP subnet. Role to be revoked automatically after window and documented in runbook.
resolution_plan: 1) Approve time-bound bridge role for 72 hours with constraints (auth to create will be given to cloud-ops).
2) Cloud-ops creates AWS role and GCP service account binding during maintenance window and posts IAM ARNs to this ticket.
3) SRE runs validation job and posts successful collection artifacts (metrics snapshots, checksums) to ticket.
4) Audit: ensure CloudTrail and Cloud Logging show assume/actAs events; attach logs to ticket.
5) Post-window: automated revoke/cleanup job will remove bindings and rotate any temporary credentials; cloud-ops to confirm cleanup and close ticket.
